require consecutive matches, K matches in the last N decision rounds, or K total matches since the start.
offsets are basis points from the current mid. Negative means below the mid; positive means above it. 100 bps = 1%.
No signal is emitted before an indicator has enough data. Both signals at once are skipped. Cash/position percentages size the order; the trading engine validates capital and fills.
